imageGalleries.title: Wild Turkey
imageGalleries.description: This is a mix media sketch of a wild turkey in Rocky mountains.In order to draw it,I broke down the sketch in simple organic shapes like the pieces of jigsaw puzzle. Later worked on finer details. I have used thin point pen to do hatching and crosshatching shading to show the darker values.furthermore,I used shading pencils eg.2B, 6B to enhance the sketch.

imageGalleries.title: Corn On the Cob
imageGalleries.description:
Corn is widely used in Autumn harvest festival in America.It is a staple food in many regions of the world.Do yo remember yummy crispy breakfast of cornflakes soaked in milk.Boiled corn on the cob sprinkled with parmesan cheeses itself delectable.

Inspired by Yummy corn of Thanksgiving dinner table, I have sketched the "Corn on the cob" along with its husk and golden kernels. I used fine point black pen or sharpie to trace the contour lines.Base layer of sketch is created through smooth shading with soft charcoal pencil. Hatching and crosshatching i.e criss cross lines are done to show the details of each of the kernels. Part of the husk attached to the cob is shown darker as compared to the parts to show the element of light falling on the sketch.

imageGalleries.title: Meditating Buddha
imageGalleries.description:
"I teach suffering, its origin, cessation and path. That's all I teach", declared the Buddha 2500 years ago. Buddhism is a tradition and belief that teaches personal spiritual development.

Here is modern representation of meditating Buddha. In my opinion, today's materialistic world is in deep need of spiritual thinking to maintain peace and harmony among each other.

imageGalleries.title: Laughing Budai
imageGalleries.description:
In chinese culture, Laughing Budai was a Zen monk carrying loads of good fortune at his back. This priest is often mistaken with Lord Buddha. Budai is considered as a symbol of Good luck, guardian for children,spreading happiness to all the places wherever people believe in him. In Japanese culture Similar figure God Hotei is one of the seven lucky God.

Here Lighter and Darker Values of gray are used to show the brightened and the shadowy part on the face. Darkest value is obtained through Soft Charcoal Pencil and is blended with medium and harder Charcoal pencils with help of stump or soft tissue paper. Further, shading areas are smoothened through light use of kneaded eraser on them. Highlights are given on face through thin lines done through kneaded eraser.

In ancient Egypt Falcon represents one of the god named Horus. It is a god of healing. Right eye of Falcon represents The Sun and left eye The Moon.

In this sketch various Line patterns are used to show Texture of the feathers.Golden metallic colors depicts the royalness of this statue.

imageGalleries.title: Farm Cow
imageGalleries.description:
First thought that comes in our mind regarding farm, is cow. Farm is incomplete without cow. It is a source of vitamins and minerals rich dairy products. Keeping importance of cow in mind, I have drawn a relaxed cow devouring green grass.  While sketching, I used concept of aerial perspective i.e. far things appear smaller in size and duller in details. Things nearer to viewer appear bigger and with clear details. As a result this cow seems bigger in size in front and tapers at its back, creating illusion of space around it. Painting becomes duller and less detailed in background as compared to foreground.

For coloring  I have used different tones of brown for cow to show the hairy texture and different tones of green for grass. Grass texture is done using hatching in different directions. Lots of details are added for eyes and front face of the cow.

imageGalleries.title: Cow
imageGalleries.description: Here I have drawn a Cow using organic lines and basic shapes. I have used a variation of thick and thin lines. I have shown various onomatopoeia words like Moo, Splat to exaggerate animated character of Cow. Further,  smooth shading is done through pencil colors using variety of colors.One can try the same piece using acrylic colors or mix of different mediums too.

imageGalleries.title: Pet Dog
imageGalleries.description: Dogs are men true friend. This dog is little different from others because here I have used Analogous color scheme for paint. In Analogous color scheme, three or four colors which lie side by side on color wheel, are used to create realistic affect. Tint, tones and shades of colors can be used. Here I have used Green, Blue and Purple as basic colors, and later I created numerous tint, tones and shades of these colors by mixing black and white in different proportions.

imageGalleries.title: Batman
imageGalleries.description:
This is symbol of our mystic Superhero Batman. Bat is only mammal that can fly like birds. There  are always stories of bats associated with vampires, draculas etc. Here First, I have done hatching and cross hatching in various directions through black gel pen to show the skin texture of bat. Later I colored it with black and grey tones. At last, I colored the background Yellow.

This piece can also be done in acrylics or oil pastels.

imageGalleries.title: Batman
imageGalleries.description:
Batman is fictional Superhero of comic world.  In Comic world Batman is known for his muscle power, intellect, physic abilities. He uses lot of aids which are through scientific innovation. His Batmobile is awesome , I wish I can have that someday.

This is three fourth view of batman face. I have used thick lines to enhance the mystic character of this superhero. One can try Gray color instead of blue. This piece can also be experimented in different mediums, like pencil colors, oil pastels or crayons.

imageGalleries.title: Spider Man
imageGalleries.description: Spiderman is fictional Superhero of comic world.He has special spider like characteristics which make him saviour of New York city. It is one of the favourite costume for children on Halloween. In this piece I  have drawn only his face. Lots of curved lines are there on his face mask, depicting web like pattern.Latter I have painted it with Crimson and Scarlet acrylic colors. Half of the face has lighter values as compared to other half. This piece can be experimented in different mediums like pencil colors, oil pastels or crayons too.

imageGalleries.title: Still Life Cross Hatching
imageGalleries.description:
Still life is a separate genre of paintings. This genre consists of all the items used in daily life which are man made or cannot move by themselves. Once you develop an interest for drawing and painting of this genre, possibilities  of subject for artwork are numerous. Different color mediums like, Oil Pastels, Charcoal pencils, Shading Pencils, Pencil Colors , Acrylic Colors etc can be used to create an artwork for these type of paintings.



Here I have drawn a Greek style ceramic vase and a woven fruit basket on the floor. Both the subjects of the painting, are related to ancient  greek culture. Texture of basket is depicted through fine detailed criss cross hatching. Shadow of vase and basket is falling on the floor, and is shown through detailed smooth shading and hatching techniques.

imageGalleries.title: Popping Pop Corn
imageGalleries.description:
Eating popcorns during movie time is world’s popular culture. Sound of popcorns popping up is just amazing! 



For sketching the paper bag two point Perspective view is used. Sahdowy part of paper is shown through shading techniques like hatching, cross hatching, smudging etc. To add variety, I have also used some bright yellow color for popcorns.

imageGalleries.title: Sea Turtle
imageGalleries.description: Sea turtles are dynamic creatures of oceans. They are the fundamental link in marine ecosystem and holds  a great cultural significance. Throughout the world mythologies, turtles are considered to be wise and patient creatures. In Hindu mythology sea turtles are considered to be avatar of Lord Vishnu.

imageGalleries.title: Christmas : Santa's Cap
imageGalleries.description:
Santa Claus or father of Christmas is it's most popular and celebrated figure , in western culture during month of December. He wears a red coat with white collar, red trousers, A black belt, red cap and caries gifts for children at Christmas eve. Kids love to wait for Christmas for their gifts from Santa.



I have tried to capture  a Christmas moment by remembering Santa through his red and white cap.

imageGalleries.title: Christmas : Festive Bow
imageGalleries.description: Various symbols of Christmas are star, red bow, fir tree, candy cane, wreath tinsel etc. Each of them have a specific meaning for the Christmas story. For example a red bow  signifies how we all should be together as a family ,and  as well as a community in goodwill.

imageGalleries.title: Christmas : Holly
imageGalleries.description:
Holly is an evergreen plant with prickly leaves and red attractive berries. It is popular plant for Christmas time decorations. Thorny leaves of Holly represent the difficulties and pain, which Jesus went through and red berries represents  his blood shed for their beliefs.



I have drawn the sketch in a easy way. Different color medium like Oil pastels or Pencil colors can be used to show the smooth blending of colors in leaves and berries.

imageGalleries.title: Christmas : Angel, messanger of God
imageGalleries.description:
Holy Angel are always a part of Christmas story. Even today they have a special place at the top of Christmas tree. Famous story says that Angel came in dreams of mother Mary before Jesus was born. They are considered to be a messenger of God.



Here I have drawn a mythical Angel with wings. Free fall of its garment is shown through various lines and shading.

imageGalleries.title: Christmas : Tree
imageGalleries.description:
Christmas tree symbolizes winter festival celebrated around the world. Nowadays plastic Christmas tree are easily available in departmental stores, but having a real Fir tree in house is  still an excitement. Tree is decorated with small hangings, Lightings, Ornaments made of glass, wood etc.



Here I have Drawn a Christmas Tree using Straight diagonal  lines. It is an excellent practice lesson to learn  use of lines, to draw various Shape. For tree I used Monochromatic color scheme in  Green Hue/ Color.  Monochromatic color scheme uses a single color , its Tints , Tones, and Shades.

imageGalleries.title: Christmas : Snowy the Snowman
imageGalleries.description:
Sculpting a Snowman is all time favourite activity for kids. Traditionally, a Snowman is made through round balls of compressed ice, and  eyes are represented through coal, nose through carrot , hands through thin wooden sticks.



To show winter effect on "Snowy" I have added a woollen cap and blue tie. I left Snowman white, to show small line Hatching i.e Tick Hatching on its sides. As a result this artwork is a mix of Colors and Pen. Instead of pen, one can also use black marker.

imageGalleries.title: Christmas : Olaf the Snowman
imageGalleries.description:
Olaf is one of the famous character of movie Frozen. It is little funny and a bit silly sometimes. Here I  have shown details of three blue buttons on its body,  by blending different tones of blue color. Furthermore a little shadow is shown on one side of body and legs through hatching and shading techniques.



You know, one key piece is missing in this depiction. Feel free to use your imagination. Generally its depicted favorite food of a bunny.

imageGalleries.title: Christmas : Gingerbread man
imageGalleries.description: Winter is all about delicious cakes, breads, gingerbread, pastries, cookies  and hot chocolate. In Shrek movie, Gingerbread man is one of his friend. "Ginger guy" is naughty and silly  but a yummy treat to eat. It is made of gingerbread.

imageGalleries.title: Día de Muertos (Mexican Festival)
imageGalleries.description:
The ‘Day of Dead’ is an ancient traditional holiday of Mexican culture. It falls in ninth month of Aztec Calendar.This festival acknowledges love for people who are resting in peace, and also symbolizes Cycle of Life.



On this day families visit cemeteries, to be with the souls of departed and loved ones. They decorate graves with orange Mexican Marigold. Common symbol for the festival is the Skull, which participants wear in form of a Mask.

imageGalleries.title: Freddy the Frog
imageGalleries.description:
Frogs are famous characters in children’s stories. The idea of metamorphosis of a tadpole, gives a wide range of imagination of its conversion into a charming handsome prince or a fairy. Thus they are popular fictional characters.  Frogs are Amphibians, blessed to live in water as well as land. Generally frogs are in green grassy colors but various types of colorful frogs are also present.



Here "Freddy the Frog" is handsome charming hero of my fairytale.

imageGalleries.title: Googly Worm
imageGalleries.description: Do you know some  worms keep soil healthy? This Googly worm is one of them. It helps to keep soil aerated by eating up the soil. This aerations helps the soil to be more fertile. As a result plants grow a lot more faster if these worms "Earthworms" are present in soil.

imageGalleries.title: Sea Horse
imageGalleries.description:
Seahorse are one of the fascinating character of fairy tales. Legends describe them as magical creatures. In nature they are small marine fishes. Seahorse get their name because their tiny head looks like head of a horse.



Here I have drawn an animated Seahorse. I have defined animated characters through Spectacles, and a tie. Lot of Bright rainbow colors are used. I have worked on the details through scumbling with pencil colors  Texture is also depicted through Hatching technique using black  and colorful random lines.

imageGalleries.title: Blue Bird
imageGalleries.description:
We are lucky to see few Blue Birds during Summer time. Sometimes they are sitting on thin small branches of trees, while at other time resting near the mailbox. Here I have broken down the shape of a bird in  simple Shapes. Latter through Shades of Blues and Red, I created my own style Blue- Red Bird.



Here Bird is carrying a twig, ready for nesting.

imageGalleries.title: Colorful Line Fish
imageGalleries.description:
Countless colorful fishes are found in nature’s water bodies. Drawing a fish is a good practice lesson for an artist to know about first Element of art "Lines". Here I have used Diagonal lines, Organic lines, Small C shape lines,Circle lines,Wavy Lines to draw a fish. I have Also created a pattern in the fins. Pattern represents repetition of certain lines in an order. I have used RAINBOW color theme to create a vibrant fish. This theme give us a feeling of happiness, freshness, and helps us  to connect to the nature.



ROYGBIV  is an acronym  representing seven colors of rainbow  from outward to inward . Here R is red, O is Orange, Y is Yellow, G is Green, B is Blue, I is Indigo, V is Violet.

imageGalleries.title: Orchid
imageGalleries.description: This is a good example to depict different aspects of depth.First underpainting is done with different tones of Green and Blue color to create a base layer. Flower in front is being shown as a big flower in comparison of grass and other flower. Prominence has been given to shades to depict source of light. Each twig is painted in multiple tones of green for light impression. Detailed features are painted on front flower to create focus area, whereas the one in back has not been made visually prominent.

imageGalleries.title: Afghan Hound Dog
imageGalleries.description:
Afghan Hound is one of a popular and glamourous dog in the rings. In wild,  it is a hunter, but as a pet  it is a peaceful "catlike" dog. People are attracted because of its volume of fur which makes him look royal.



I have used Oil Pastels for this particular piece. Key to this artwork is patience. Several layers of fur is created using different tones of brown, orange and black color. Using different colors to create thin, thick and curvy and organic lines according to the contour of the dog’s body. Blending colors of one layer and building  several other on top of previous one give the illusion of  dog’s fur as together.

pages.title: Fuel their future, color their world.
pages.pageDescription: While academics build a strong foundation, art unlocks a child's true imagination. We make learning art simple, structured, and fun. From mastering colors and tools to exploring seasonal themes, our bite-sized exercises match every skill level, whether your child is a curious beginner or an enthused young artist.

pages.title: Self Work
pages.pageDescription: My artwork is inspired by my journeys, experiences, and observations of diverse cultures and artistic traditions. Through painting and drawing, I explore colors, forms, and stories that reflect the beauty of nature, people, and heritage. Each piece is a reflection of my continuous learning and passion for creative expression.

pages.title: Art Concepts
pages.pageDescription:
Understanding of different elements, medium and tools play a very important role. Based on our expertise level and target project, we need to choose right medium and tools for effective output.

Lets dive through in details on each of these topics.

pages.title: Student Work
pages.pageDescription: This collection showcases the creativity, imagination, and artistic growth of students of all ages. Each artwork reflects a unique perspective, highlighting individual expression, skill development, and the joy of creative exploration.

pages.title: Sketchbook
pages.pageDescription:
Sketchbooks are really good to manage and organize our work. Sketchbooks become quite handy to work with, and helps to maintain a collection. Collection creates a pleasing memory, with each page it helps to build our confidence.

For younger kids it's good to buy a smaller size sketchbook, so that they remain focussed while using it, because attention time is really short .

With age, we can buy more expensive sketchbooks. Sketchbook comes in different sizes and prices, and have varied paper quality.

pages.title: Canvas
pages.pageDescription: Canvas is a stretched piece of cloth mounted on the wooden frame. They are easily available in art supplies store and come in different sizes.For acrylic colors one can start with a small size canvas, set of flat and round brushes, paper plate to mix colors and a set of primary colors.

pages.title: Brushes
pages.pageDescription:
For watercolor/ acrylic or oil colors we require different set of brushes. A beginner can start with a pair of round brushes, one 3 and other 5 number on a A4 size paper.

Later on as one  develops an interest and becomes familiar with watercolors, we can buy a set of flat and round brushes as well as  good quality cold pressed thick watercolor paper.

pages.title: Crayons
pages.pageDescription:
Crayons can be the primary starting color medium for kids.They come in form of small sticks. As soon as kids learn to hold something, they can easily hold crayons because they are small in size and simple to work.. They are budget friendly.

Kids from age of 2 1/2 and onward can easily explore them. Later on kids can use crayons along with other mediums such as pencil colors, watercolors, to create a unique effect. A basic set of 12 crayons is good to start with.

For advance art work, Crayons are not good choice. We can not create good shading effect.

Recommended Age : 2 years +

pages.title: Pencil Colors
pages.pageDescription:
Pencil Colors are another popular form of coloring medium. These are similar to standard black pencils used by everyone with colors.We can generally buy them in a set of 6 or 12. While coloring, they create a good shading and blending effect.They are also good to show gradation effect in colors.

We have to be little patient while using Pencil colors. Sometimes they leave marks on the paper. Kids from age 6 and onwards can easily explore them.

Recommended Age : 6 years +

pages.title: Oil Pastels
pages.pageDescription:
For a long time, artists are using pastels as a color medium.  Oil Pastels are a mix of wax and oil pigments. If we are familiar with Crayons, next step is to explore oil pastels.

Oil pastels are usually available  in form of small sticks, in a pack of 12 or 24. They create effective  blends and  highlights. These colors create a shining effect on paper.

Once we know the fundamentals to create different colors and their respective tones and shades,  we will always enjoy working with oil pastels. For oil pastels  colors cannot be mixed separately on the palate. All mixing and blending occurs directly on paper.

They  are little messy to work with, but the end result is quite astonishing .

Recommended Age : 7 years +

pages.title: Water Colors
pages.pageDescription:
Water Colors are  great to express  imagination. Watercolors comes in tubes or tablets. Generally, kids are excited to work with water colors. We simply need a watercolor set , a pair of round brushes and a paper to start with.They are really good to try for different painting technique

For younger kids it is always helpful to buy tablet ones. These can easily be mixed with small amount of water. As one becomes familiar with them, one can shift for tube ones. Good quality cold pressed paper is used to show watercolor techniques more effectively.

Recommended Age : 5 years +

pages.title: Oil Colors
pages.pageDescription:
Oil Colors are used by artists since historic times.They comes in different tube sizes. Canvases  of different sizes are used for oil paintings. We have to prepare the canvas  to use them. Solvents are used to mix the colors or to bring  a color to a particular viscosity. Different type of varnishes and oils are also used along with them.

They are really good to create different layers and for blending  smoothly. But, since drying time is long process of oil  painting takes a lot of time.

Once we are familiar with few of other mediums ,we can work with oil colors.

Recommended Age : 12 years +

pages.title: Acrylic Colors
pages.pageDescription:
Acrylic colors are the most versatile medium. They comes in bottles or tubes. Great advantage is one can work with them on paper, canvas, cloth, wood or anything.

As compared to oil colors they are quite less expensive. They don't require any special  soluble agent. Water is simply the best solvent for them. We can experiment with with them on flat canvases or paper with a pack of flat brushes.They are good to create crisp edges but not so good for blending. However they dries out really fast.

Recommended Age : 8 years +

pages.title: About Me
pages.pageDescription:
My name is Shipra Agarwal. I am a homemaker and a mother with a long-standing passion for art. Over the years, I have been an enthusiastic student and observer of various art forms, experimenting with different styles of painting and drawing to broaden my understanding and creative expression. 

 I have been fortunate to live in and explore several countries, which has given me the opportunity to experience diverse artistic traditions and creative practices. My travels have also inspired me to learn about the unique customs, crafts, and artistic expressions of indigenous and tribal communities around the world.

This journey has been both exciting and enriching. Through this platform, I hope to share my experiences, insights, and artistic learnings with a wider audience, and inspire others through the beauty and diversity of art.

pages.pageDescription:
Buddha is a primary figure of Buddhism. According to ancient texts,  buddha earlier known as prince Gautama was born in Lumbini, present day  part of Nepal and raised in city of Kapilvastu. He achieved the highest state of enlightenment under the bodhi tree of Bodh Gaya gave his first sermon in Sarnath and died in Kushinagar

pages.title: Pop Art
pages.pageDescription:
Pop art was the movement of art that prevailed in late 1950’s in America and Great Britain. This is an art that is inspired by everyday life and culture. This revolutionary art helped to create a link between art and common people.Subject matter of Pop Art are common advertisement, commercials, media, politics, fashion etc. This style helps an artist to use different mediums, along with printmaking, photography and collage together. Colors are often bold, using complementary color scheme straight from tubes.

Roy lichtenstein is one of my famous Pop Art artist. Let’s explore famous comic characters through this art.
